headline: Gold Price Nears $4,750 on Iran Peace Hopes — Analyst Predicts 'Strongest Bull Market in History'
summary: Gold prices approached $4,750 an ounce on hopes of a US-Iran peace deal. An analyst cited central bank buying, currency debasement and rising US debt as supporting factors.
why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors and central banks hold as a hedge against geopolitical stress, inflation and currency weakness.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold is the asset whose price is discussed in relation to peace-deal expectations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of a US-Iran peace deal are reducing geopolitical risk premia, while the analyst cites structural drivers such as central bank buying and debt concerns.
